name: Missing Loop
hint: If a statement should be executed as soon as a condition is met, one has to be careful about the timing. The condition has to be checked at the right time or repeatedly.
instruction: Consider using a loop like [sbi]forever[/sbi] or [sbi]repeat until < >[/sbi]that surrounds your [sbi]if < > then[/sbi].[newLine]In some cases, using a [sbi]wait until < >[/sbi] instead of your [sbi]if < > then[/sbi] could be sufficient, too.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <touching (mouse-pointer v) ?:: #ff0000 > then //⇦  🐛
turn left (15) degrees

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
forever :: #007000 //⇦  👍
if <touching (mouse-pointer v)> then
turn left (15) degrees
